signal: Symetri acquired SolidCAD, an Autodesk Platinum Partner in Canada, adding ~150 employees and expanding its AECO reach across the Americas.

email.body1:
Paul, saw Symetri acquired SolidCAD, adding around 150 people and extending your AECO reach across the Americas.

A big acquisition usually means more key accounts in play than the team can cover before everything integrates, and that is where pipeline goes cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a signal play for Symetri off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress ~4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Paul, quick follow-up for Symetri.

After absorbing SolidCAD, the combined AECO account list grows faster than a key-accounts team can work it. Most orgs don't know exactly how many meetings they need to hit target, so the gap shows up late in the quarter.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show how many meetings your key-accounts motion needs to close that gap, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Paul, last bit of proof for Symetri.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks.

I pulled a benchmark of how Symetri's reply rate likely compares to peer AECO-tech firms. Want to hop on a quick call and I will walk you through it?
email.body4:
Paul, I will stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount isn't a priority while SolidCAD integrates, no problem at all. An acquisition quarter is its own kind of busy, and timing matters.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your key-accounts motion? I will tailor it to Symetri either way.
